_comment: P3G.2 (#22) PR-blocking gate baseline. pass_rate is (passed / (passed + failed)) among NON-xfail cases for the category, from a clean `pytest evals/ -m "not integration"` run -- see evals/conftest.py's pytest_sessionfinish hook and evals/runner/gate.py. Regenerate by running the suite and updating a category's pass_rate deliberately (in its own commit, with a reason) whenever an intentional, reviewed change lowers it -- never to silence an unexplained regression.

citation_present._note: #100 (this re-verification superseded the #58/#81 note below): the committed 5/12 baseline's 5 non-xfail cases (bp-stage2-question, a1c-target-question, dual-antiplatelet-question, hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question, lithium-nsaid-question) each reflected one STABLE, frozen recording from an earlier draw that was never re-checked against a fresh live draw. Re-running all 5 live (8-10 independent fresh draws each, real pipeline, production LlamaServerClient, no replay) found every one of them fails to reliably reproduce `verified` today -- bp-stage2/dual-antiplatelet/hypertension-lifestyle-followup failed 100% of live draws (deterministically), a1c-target passed only 1/8 (12.5%), and lithium-nsaid never reached `verified` in 8/8 (though its citation itself surfaced in half of those). All 5 recordings have been re-captured against current main with a typical (non-passing) live draw and are now honestly marked xfail -- see each case file's xfail rationale and docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md for the full writeup. pass_rate is 1.0 because CategoryStats.pass_rate treats an all-xfail category as a vacuous pass (nothing left to regress), NOT because any case passes -- honest gate-ON total is now 0/12, down from the previously-committed 5/12.
